captions.detailed: A clip-on drafting lamp featuring a black double-jaw clamp base, a two-link articulated arm, and a dark green conical shade. The first link of the arm is connected to the top of the clamp's post via a swiveling revolute joint. The second link pivots relative to the first on a central elbow joint, while the lamp shade tilts on a final revolute joint at the tip of the second arm.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated clip-on drafting lamp with a double-jaw clamp base, a two-link arm, and a cone-shaped shade. The lamp must include a revolute joint where the first arm meets the clamp post, a revolute joint connecting the two arm links, and a tilting revolute joint at the shade connection.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a C-shaped box clamp and a vertical cylinder post. Build the two arm links using pairs of parallel cylinder rods connected by cylindrical hinge pins. Model the shade by lofting or combining concentric cylinders and a cone, then assemble all parts into an ArticulatedObject with three revolute joints: a yaw joint at the base post, a pitch joint at the elbow, and a pitch joint at the shade holder.
